headline: Amazon to Launch Vehicle Sales in UK Market in 2027
summary: Amazon plans to enter the British vehicle retail market in early 2027, starting with a partnership with South Korean manufacturer Hyundai. The move aims to disrupt the traditional automotive sales model.
why: Amazon's entry into new retail sectors often forces traditional competitors to adapt their business models. This partnership highlights the expansion of e-commerce into high-value consumer goods.

impacts.name: Hyundai
impacts.why: New distribution channels through Amazon could increase sales volume for the automaker.
